sourceBoundProofInterpretation.blocklist: A passing shell_blocklist stage follows a public start_process denial predicate and filesystem ENOENT check for an owned prefix marker; raw response/sentinel probe are not separately persisted.
sourceBoundProofInterpretation.process: A passing owned_process_output_and_tree_cleanup stage follows fixture nonce verification, two owned PIDs live, bounded three-line tail check and both PIDs no longer live. Candidate uses kill_process; control uses force_terminate.
sourceBoundProofInterpretation.pdf: A passing pdf_create_and_read_fidelity stage follows public write_pdf success, %PDF- bytes, length greater than1000, and public read_file text matching MTERM PDF FIXTURE. Windows saves PDF size/hash; original PDF bytes and readback text are not archived.
sourceBoundProofInterpretation.eof: ConfiguredStdioTransport.close only ends the owned child stdin, without signals. Harness waits completed; all4 lanes record childExited true/exit0/upstreamExited true/ownedProcessTreeExited true. Overall pass additionally requires !closed.signaled.
sourceBoundProofInterpretation.admission: Only Windows reaches admission_released, whose assertion checks available true and inflight, queued, uncertain all0.

limitations: Windows success is bounded to these fixtures, exact packages, Node24 and hosted Windows environment.
Linux PDF failure has no underlying error text/class/binary path in the retained report, so its cause remains unestablished here.
Persisted search observations and native hashes can be independently checked; blocklist/process/PDF/EOF outcomes also rely on the exact reviewed harness assertions and its recorded completion flags.

Original PDFs, raw process output and raw blocklist response/sentinel observations are not archived. This limits independent reproduction from artifacts without invalidating the source-bound assertions.
No complete cross-platform qualification, merge approval or production rollout is asserted.
